positioning: Displacement-focused sales intelligence for manufacturing teams that reveals competitor contract details and refresh timing at the account level.
coreFeatures: Account-level competitor installed-base mapping with verified contacts
Contract detail tracking including renewal dates and terms
Priority scoring to rank displacement opportunities
differentiators: Manufacturing-specific focus on entrenched competitor displacement
Contract-level granularity with refresh date intelligence
Priority scoring tailored for displacement selling motions
mvpBuildPlan: Define target manufacturing verticals and competitor set
Build data pipeline for contract and refresh date aggregation
Develop priority scoring algorithm and sales UI
risks: Data accuracy and freshness for contract-level details
Legal and compliance around competitive intelligence gathering
Adoption friction if not integrated into existing CRM workflows
valueProposition: Enables displacement selling by revealing exactly where competitors are entrenched, with contract-level detail and refresh timing, so reps can prioritize high-probability accounts.
